groups.name: streamrune.crypto
groups.description: Crypto engine configuration (immutable; bound once at startup).

properties.name: streamrune.snapshot-every-n-events
properties.description: Number of events between automatic snapshots

properties.name: streamrune.retry-max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum retry attempts for optimistic lock conflicts

properties.name: streamrune.retry-initial-delay-ms
properties.description: Initial delay in milliseconds between retry attempts

properties.name: streamrune.retry-backoff-multiplier
properties.description: Backoff multiplier for retry delays

properties.name: streamrune.polling-interval-ms
properties.description: Subscription polling interval in milliseconds

properties.name: streamrune.polling-jitter-ms
properties.description: Random jitter added to polling interval in milliseconds

properties.name: streamrune.lock-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for acquiring aggregate locks

properties.name: streamrune.event-store.statement-timeout
properties.description: Bound on every statement the event store runs, applied per transaction or per statement (never on the pooled session); 0s sets none

properties.name: streamrune.stripe-count
properties.description: Number of stripes for the local striped locker

properties.name: streamrune.circuit-breaker-failure-threshold
properties.description: Number of consecutive failures to trip the circuit breaker

properties.name: streamrune.circuit-breaker-cooldown
properties.description: Time the circuit breaker stays open before allowing a probe

properties.name: streamrune.event-audit-enabled
properties.description: Enable per-event audit logging

properties.name: streamrune.projection-dlq-enabled
properties.description: Enable projection dead letter queue

properties.name: streamrune.saga.enabled
properties.description: Enable saga auto-configuration

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.enabled
properties.description: Enable outbox polling (opt-in, requires message broker)

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum events per outbox poll cycle

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.flush-interval-ms
properties.description: Outbox polling interval in milliseconds

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.skipped-retention-max-age
properties.description: How long to keep SKIPPED outbox entries (the audit of an operator's skip) before the retention sweeper prunes them; zero or negative disables the SKIPPED sweep. FAILED entries are never pruned

properties.name: streamrune.dead-letter.enabled
properties.description: Enable the automatic dead letter retry runner. Only the automatic replays: the command bus keeps dead-lettering into a DeadLetterQueue bean and the retention sweeper keeps pruning it

properties.name: streamrune.dead-letter.max-retries
properties.description: Maximum retry attempts before permanent failure

properties.name: streamrune.dead-letter.retry-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval between dead letter retry attempts in milliseconds

properties.name: streamrune.dead-letter.retention-max-age
properties.description: How long to keep command dead-letter-queue entries (which hold command payloads) before the retention sweeper prunes them; zero or negative disables pruning. Independent of streamrune.dead-letter.enabled

properties.name: streamrune.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable Micrometer metrics publishing

properties.name: streamrune.metrics.prefix
properties.description: Metric name prefix for all StreamRune metrics

properties.name: streamrune.validation-enabled
properties.description: Enable command validation interceptor via JSR-380

properties.name: streamrune.startup-log
properties.description: Log StreamRune banner and configuration summary at startup

properties.name: streamrune.subscription.single-active-consumer.enabled
properties.description: Enable single-active-consumer subscription leadership so at most one replica of each projection/subscription is the active consumer (requires a DataSource); when false or absent, runners always lead (single-instance behavior)

properties.name: streamrune.subscription.health.lag-threshold
properties.description: Lag, in events between the head of the event stream and a subscription's checkpoint, at or above which a running subscription is reported DEGRADED in the health details. Lag never turns the health indicator DOWN (it is part of /health/readiness): only a stopped or terminally halted subscription does. At least 1

properties.name: streamrune.runner-lifecycle-enabled
properties.description: Automatically start and stop projection runners, outbox poller, and dead letter retry runner with the application context

properties.name: streamrune.sse.timeout
properties.description: How long an SSE stream may stay open before the server completes it (dead-client reaping). Finite so a half-open client on an idle stream is reaped and its subscription, worker and socket FD released; zero or negative disables it, leaving the keepalive as the sole reaper

properties.name: streamrune.sse.keep-alive-interval
properties.description: How often a keepalive comment frame is written to every SSE subscriber (dead-client reaping). Detection requires a write, so an idle stream needs this to surface a dead peer; zero or negative disables it

properties.name: streamrune.sse.polling-interval
properties.description: How often the SSE endpoint's feed reads the global stream for new events: the upper bound on the delay between a commit and its frame. The feed starts at the head of the global stream when the application starts and delivers live, best-effort and at-most-once. Must be positive

properties.name: streamrune.security.trust-user-id-header
properties.description: Trusted-gateway mode: when true, the request filter and the SSE endpoint take the authorization identity (RequestContext.userId) from the X-User-Id header, even when Micronaut Security is present. Enable it only when a gateway in front of the service authenticates every caller, overwrites X-User-Id with the authenticated id and strips any client-supplied value, and the service is reachable only through that gateway; otherwise any client can act as any user. When false, the identity is the authenticated principal if an AuthenticatedUserResolver is available (Micronaut Security enabled), and otherwise every request is anonymous and the header is ignored; in that anonymous mode a configured CommandAuthorizationPolicy or UserRoleResolver refuses startup

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.cache.enabled
properties.description: Whether the decrypted-plaintext crypto cache wraps the engine. false skips the cache entirely so no decrypted PII is retained in heap (the no-cache GDPR posture).

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.cache.maximum-size
properties.description: Maximum number of entries in the crypto cache.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.cache.expire-after-write
properties.description: Duration after which a cached crypto entry expires once written; also the only cross-replica erasure bound when no DataSource wires the forget channel.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.cache.expire-after-access
properties.description: Duration after which a cached crypto entry expires when not accessed. Unset disables access-based expiry.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.filesystem.enabled
properties.description: Enable the file system crypto engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.filesystem.key-directory
properties.description: Directory holding the file system engine's encryption keys. Required when the engine is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.postgres.enabled
properties.description: Enable the PostgreSQL crypto engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.postgres.table-name
properties.description: Key-table name of the PostgreSQL engine; must be a plain SQL identifier. The shipped migration creates only the default-named table, so a custom name requires creating that table.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.vault.enabled
properties.description: Enable the HashiCorp Vault crypto engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.vault.address
properties.description: Vault server address.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.vault.token
properties.description: Vault authentication token. Required when the Vault engine is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.vault.engine-mount
properties.description: Mount path of the Vault transit engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.aws.enabled
properties.description: Enable the AWS KMS crypto engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.aws.region
properties.description: AWS region of the KMS key. Required when the AWS KMS engine is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.aws.kms-key-id
properties.description: AWS KMS key id or ARN. Required when the AWS KMS engine is enabled.
